decision: FAILED BUILD_CHECKLIST item 3 (HARD): drop-ring arrivals base 0 5 -> 3 (seed 44, 2 -> 0, a fired game). Flag stays false; no flag-on commit. Fix not attempted: no near-and-reachable drop gate can block the detours that lose drops (see diagnosis).
blocker: The drop losses come from trajectory divergence after detours taken while no drop is within DROP_RUN_M (often none listed at all). The only gate that blocks them is 'any drop listed', which the Coordinator rule forbids, and P37 had exactly that gate and still lost 4 arrivals on the screen.
next_action: Coordinator: retire P37b, or decide whether any heal-pickup variant is worth a different drop protection. Builder stopped.
source: P37 PR #149 Sim Tester veto (https://github.com/dmclaughlin-bit/mech-bot/pull/149#issuecomment-7072563191: drop-ring arrivals 8->7 and 7->4, all lost arrivals in fired games; survival 6->5 from seed 3012) + Coordinator drop-gate rule (gate on a drop near and reachable within DROP_RUN_M, never on 'any drop exists')
sources: /tmp/p37b (head CSVs, traces, diag runs; not committed)
drop_gate: healCube is blocked when dropRun !== null || dropHold || dropMove || any drop with holder null or us is within DROP_RUN_M (200 m) of us: the champion's dropOpen() test (brain.ts lethal release) plus dropHold/dropMove, and !farmHold (capture). farmOk already excludes leaveNow (walk to the next circle) and being out of the zone. The branch ranks below drop hold/run, so a drop wins on the same tick. What it adds over the champion: the champion has no heal detour, so its drop logic gates nothing here; the gate only matters later in the game, once a drop has been called within 200 m. What it changes vs P37: P37 required obs.drops to be empty (the forbidden 'any drop exists' gate), so P37b's gate is LOOSER than P37's, not tighter.
implementation: brain.ts: healPick/healSkip state; in act(), healCube computed after the drop run block (HEAL_PICKUP_ON, obs.t >= HEAL_PICKUP_T 10, farmOk, farmGoal is an obs.cubes cube, !farmHunt, !farmHold, HP < 90%, drop gate above, cube not in healSkip; 3 s / 1 m no-progress give-up -> healSkip). One branch `} else if (healCube)` immediately before the stand-still heal branch, travel() to the cube, mode 'heal, pickup'. params.ts: HEAL_PICKUP_ON=false, HEAL_PICKUP_T=10, HEAL_PICKUP_STUCK_S=3.

diagnosis.veto_detours_vs_gate: The screened P37 (f174d55 brain.ts:755) only detoured when obs.drops was EMPTY, so every veto detour behind a lost drop (2089, 5048, 5051, 5053) and the worse deaths (3012, 3001, 4014) happened with no drop listed; neither the champion's dropOpen() nor the new gate could block any of them.
diagnosis.single_seed_trees_on: Single-seed reruns trees-on (/tmp/builder-sim-trees --worker --seed-list, champion diag rows equal the trees-0e6fadd CSVs): 2089 and 3012: no detour at all on P34 (gated = ungated = champion: 2089 place 4, 3012 place 16). 5048: gated still detours 19.0-38.8 s (183 ticks, 0 with a drop listed), place 11 -> 14, death 185.70 -> 174.85, arrivals 1 -> 0. 5051: detours 25.4-32.9 s (76 ticks, 0 drops listed), place 6 -> 11, arrivals 1 -> 0. 5053: detours 69.4-71.3 s (20 ticks, nearest drop 469 m), place 5 -> 9, death 248.60 -> 80.95. An ungated copy (drop gate removed) behaves identically on all five seeds: the gate blocks none of these detours.
diagnosis.base0_seed44: Seed 44 (base 0) lost 2 arrivals: the first detour 95.9-97.0 s ran while the only drop was 336 m away; games diverge from there. At 210-250 s the champion is within 200 m of the drops and runs (drop run 220-245 s); the head stands at full HP in 'hold' 203-234 m away, outside DROP_RUN_M, and never qualifies. Its last detour (200.1-204.8 s) was 224-236 m from the drops.
